calculate_bmi: calculate BMI from weight in kg and height in cm with weight category classification
calculate_tdee: calculate total daily energy expenditure using Mifflin-St Jeor BMR formula and activity level
estimate_one_rep_max: estimate one-rep max from weight and reps using Epley, Brzycki, and Lombardi formulas
calculate_macros: calculate daily macro split for protein, fat, and carbs based on calorie target and goal
estimate_body_fat: estimate body fat percentage using US Navy circumference method with neck, waist, and hip measurements
